blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models perform strongly on competition mathematics, but their research-level reasoning remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Theoretical computer science (TCS) connects algorithm design to explicit guarantees and fundamental limits, providing a setting for evaluating whether models can justify computational improvements with arguments humans can inspect. We introduce TCSAlgBench, a benchmark and reusable pipeline for natural-language proof discovery, comprising 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers. Expert-designed rules complete paper-specific context, preserve computational assumptions and quantitative guarantees, and withhold constructions when discovering an algorithm is part of the task. For each task, prover systems receive theorem statements and access to cited prior work. The pipeline supports fresh, versioned challenge batches from newly released papers. We evaluate ten model configurations from four families under direct inference and prover-verifier discussion, and compare four agent workflows under matched model-call opportunities. All evaluations use the full benchmark. In the model comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol max achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 23.6% after 10-round discussion. Discussion and repeated sampling improve coverage. In the separate agent comparison using GPT-5.5 xhigh, decomposition improves coverage over discussion, and agentic planning achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 25.4%. TCSAlgBench provides a refreshable testbed for measuring progress in model reasoning and studying how agent workflows support research-level proof discovery.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型在竞赛数学上表现强劲,但其研究层面的推理仍然难以系统评价. 理论计算机科学(TCS)将算法设计与明确的保证和基本限制联系起来,为评价模型是否能够证明计算改进的合理性提供了环境,人类可以检查论证. 我们引入了TCSAlg Bench,这是用于自然语言验证发现的基准和可重复使用的管道,由138份STOC和COLT 2026论文的398个定理级挑战组成. 专家设计的规则完整了具体纸张的背景,保留了计算假设和数量保证,在发现算法时扣压构造是任务的一部分. 对于每一项任务,验证系统都会收到定理语句,并访问引用的先前作品. 管道支持新发布的论文中新鲜的,版本化的挑战批次. 我们通过直接推论和验证员讨论,对来自四个家庭的10个模型配置进行评估,并根据相应的模型调用机会,比较四个代理工作流程。 所有评价都使用全部基准。 在模型比较中,GPT-5.6 Sol max在经过十轮讨论后以23.6%达到最高的五运行验证器接受率. 讨论和重复抽样扩大了覆盖面。 在使用GPT-5.5 x高的单独剂剂比较中,分解提高了讨论的覆盖度,剂剂规划达到了最高的5个运行的验证器接受率,达到25.4%. TCSAlg Bench提供了一个可更新的测试台,用于测量模型推理的进展,并研究代理工作流程如何支持研究层面的验证发现.

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved significant improvements in mathematics, from the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) to research-level problems. However, many existing benchmarks focus on competitive mathematics, while recent research-level achievements often focus on individual problems, making it difficult to systematically evaluate research-level capabilities or compare agent workflows. A broader goal for LLM research is to develop models that help improve computational systems while giving humans a basis for understanding and evaluating those improvements. Theoretical computer science (TCS) connects algorithms to explicit assumptions, mathematical guarantees, and fundamental limits. In areas such as privacy and fairness, this reasoning makes precise which property a proposed method satisfies, when the claim holds, and what tradeoffs it entails. Progress in TCS reasoning could therefore support LLMs as research collaborators whose proposals come with justifications that humans can inspect and challenge. Evaluating proof discovery in TCS tests a capability needed for this vision: reasoning about algorithms, the information they can access, and their data and computational requirements.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在数学上取得了显著的改进,从国际数学奥林匹克(IMO)到研究层次的问题. 然而,许多现有基准都侧重于竞争性数学,而近期的研究层面成就往往侧重于个别问题,因此难以系统地评价研究层面的能力或比较代理工作流程. LLM研究的一个更广泛的目标是开发有助于改进计算系统的模型,同时为人类提供了解和评价这些改进的基础. 理论计算机科学(TCS)将算法与明确的假设,数学保证,和根本限制联系起来. 在隐私和公平等领域,这种推理精确地说明了拟议方法满足哪些财产、何时提出权利要求、以及需要何种权衡。 因此,在TCS推理方面的进展可以支持LLMs作为研究合作者,其建议有人类可以检查和质疑的理由。 评估TCS中的证据发现测试了这种视觉所需的能力:对算法的推理,他们可以获取的信息,以及他们的数据和计算要求.

blocks.en: We introduce TCSAlgBench , a benchmark and construction pipeline for generating self-contained natural-language TCS statements to evaluate LLM reasoning ability, with a focus on algorithm design and sample- or runtime-complexity analysis. TCSAlgBench has three properties that make it useful for evaluating research-level reasoning. (1) Diversity. Its initial collection contains 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers, spanning learning theory, privacy, optimization, sampling, and other areas of TCS. Each challenge provides a target theorem together with its local definitions, assumptions, notation, and necessary prior work, and asks for a rigorous natural-language proof. (2) Generalization. The reusable pipeline can generate fresh, versioned challenge batches from newly released papers, allowing successive models and agent designs to be evaluated on problems published after their assumed knowledge cutoffs. The size and topic composition of each batch can be controlled, reducing reliance on a fixed benchmark that may be contaminated over time. (3) Difficulty. Current models achieve low proof coverage on TCSAlgBench even across five runs of 10-round discussion, despite strong published final-answer accuracy on selected math benchmarks ( Dekoninck et al., 2026a ) ; Figure 1 illustrates this gap.
blocks.zh: 我们引入 TCSAlg Bench, 用于生成自成一体的自然语言 TCS 语句来评价 LLM 推理能力的基准和构造管道, 重点是算法设计和样本-或运行时间-复合性分析. TCSAlg Bench有三个特性,使得它可用于评价研究层面的推理. (1) 多样性。 它的最初收藏包含138份STOC和COLT 2026论文的398个定理级挑战,涉及学习理论,隐私,优化,采样,以及TCS的其他领域. 每个挑战都提供了目标定理及其局部定义,假设,标记,以及必要的前期工作,并要求严格的自然语言证明. (2) 一般化。 可重复使用的管道可以从新发行的论文中产生新鲜的,版本化的挑战批次,使得连续的模型和代理设计能够在假定的知识断绝后被公布的问题得到评价. 每个批次的大小和专题组成可以控制,从而减少对可能随着时间的推移受到污染的固定基准的依赖。 (3)难. 目前的模型在TCSAlg Bench的验证覆盖率很低,甚至在五轮十轮讨论中也是如此,尽管已就选定的数学基准(Dekoninck等人,2026a)发表了强有力的最终答案准确性;图1说明了这一差距。

blocks.en:
A key contribution of our pipeline is a set of expert-designed rules for turning extracted theorems into fair proof-discovery problems. These rules capture details that generic theorem extraction can miss: they preserve computational models, restrictions on information access and action order, assumptions, and quantitative guarantees, while adding the definitions needed to interpret the statement. They also remove source-paper lemmas and, when algorithm design is part of the task, rewrite named
algorithms as existence claims so that the construction is not revealed. Applied in a fixed sequence to the paper’s proof-dependency graph, the rules produce self-contained problems without leaking the central argument. We developed the rules on 21 challenges and manually reviewed 61 final statements, including the development set and 40 additional challenges, for fidelity and self-containment. All headline natural-language model and workflow comparisons use the full collection of 398 challenges. We provide the prompts used in the pipeline in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
我们的管道的一个关键贡献是一套由专家设计的规则,将提取的定理转化为公平的证据发现问题。 这些规则捕捉到通用定理提取可能错过的细节:它们保存了计算模型,对信息访问和动作顺序的限制,假设,和定量保证,同时增加了解释语句所需的定义. 他们还移除了源纸lemmas,当算法设计是任务的一部分时,重写命名
算法作为存在主张,这样构造就不会被揭示. 这些规则以固定顺序适用于纸张的证明-依赖性图表,在不泄露中心论点的情况下产生自足的问题。 我们制定了关于21项挑战的规则,并手动审查了61项最后声明,包括一套发展和另外40项挑战,以便忠实和自我约束。 所有头条自然语言模型和工作流程比较都使用全集398项挑战. 我们在附录E中提供了管道中使用的提示。

blocks.en: Our evaluation measures both sources of progress in automated proof generation: the capability of the underlying model and the design of the agent built around it. Every model configuration and agent workflow is evaluated on all 398 challenges in an offline sandbox with the same fixed library of cited prior work. For model capability, we ask: Which model should TCS researchers use? In this work, we compare ten configurations from four model families under direct inference and multi-round prover–verifier discussion, with repeated runs in both settings. For agent design, we ask: Which workflow design should TCS researchers use? We compare four representative workflows that cover the main mechanisms used by proof agents: iterative refinement, explicit decomposition, tree search, and adaptive planning (Section 3.2 ). The agent comparison holds the backbone model, problem input, tool access, model-call opportunities, and per-call generation limit fixed, while reporting realized input and output tokens separately. We report both seed-1 acceptance and five-run coverage: MCTS performs best on the former, while agentic planning performs best on the latter. Finally, we re-score identical submissions with Opus 4.8 to assess how sensitive these conclusions are to the choice of verifier. As a supplementary resource, we provide 221 provisional Lean statements that pass compilation and automated semantic screening for future formalization work.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价衡量自动验证生成方面的进展来源:基本模型的能力和围绕模型的物剂的设计。 每一个模型配置和代理工作流程,都会在一个离线沙盒中对所有398项挑战进行评价,该沙盒中被引用的前作的固定库相同. 对于模型能力,我们问:TCS研究人员应该使用哪种模型? 在这项工作中,我们比较了直接推论和多轮验证器讨论的四个模范家庭的十种配置,在两种情况下都重复运行。 对于代理设计,我们问:TCS研究人员应该使用哪种工作流程设计? 我们比较了四个具有代表性的工作流程,这些工作流程涵盖验证代理人使用的主要机制:迭代精炼、明确分解、树木搜索和适应性规划(第3.2节)。 代理比较持有主干模型,问题输入,工具访问,模式调用机会,以及每个调用生成限制,同时分别报告实现的输入和输出符号. 我们报告种子一的接受率和五运行覆盖率:MCTS在前者方面表现最好,而代理规划在后者方面表现最好。 最后,我们与Opus 4.8重排相同的提交意见,以评估这些结论对选择核查者有多敏感。 作为补充资源,我们提供了221份临时精益说明,通过汇编和自动语义筛选,用于今后的正规化工作。

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are: • A scalable, refreshable benchmark-construction framework. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline that transforms recent research papers into self-contained proof challenges while preserving computational models,
restrictions on information access and action order, and complexity guarantees. The pipeline supports versioned, post-cutoff evaluation on newly released work. • A broad research-level TCS benchmark. We construct 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers spanning major areas of TCS. Each task isolates genuine proof discovery by providing only the necessary local context and cited prior work. • A controlled study of models and proof-agent design. We evaluate ten model configurations and four representative agent workflows across the full benchmark, controlling call opportunities and reporting repeated-run coverage, token costs,
and verifier sensitivity. The results expose substantial capability gaps and quantify the trade-offs among discussion, decomposition, tree search, and agentic planning.

限制信息的获取和行动秩序,以及复杂的保障。 管道支持对新发布的作品进行版本的,截止后的评价. • 广泛的研究层面的技合基准。 我们从138份STOC和COLT 2026号论文中构建了398项定理层面的挑战,涉及TCS的主要领域。 每项任务都通过仅提供必要的本地背景和引用先前的工作来隔离真正的证据发现. • 支助 对模型和验证剂设计的控制研究. 我们评价10个模型配置和4个具有代表性的代理工作流程,涵盖全部基准,控制呼叫机会,并报告重复运行的覆盖面、象征性费用,

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Mathematical evaluations span exact-answer datasets ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , difficult or fresh problems and false-premise tests ( Phan et al., 2025 ; Balunovic et al., 2026 ; Petrov et al., 2025 ) , and research-level problems ( Glazer et al., 2024 ; Schmitt et al., 2025 ; Abouzaid et al., 2026a ; Abouzaid et al., 2026b ) . Advances from competition mathematics and discovery ( Hubert et al., 2026 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Anthropic, 2026b ; Alon et al., 2026 ) to even the Navier–Stokes problem ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , alongside reported formalizations ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , motivate systematic evaluation. LemmaBench extracts self-contained lemmas from arXiv papers and supports recurring updates ( Peyronnet et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent TCS-BENCH provides 300 natural-language tasks from STOC, FOCS, and SODA, with dependency-based masking and expert-evaluated judging ( Cohen-Addad et al., 2026 ) . FormalTCS offers expert-validated instances with natural-language and Lean statements and proofs ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . TCSAlgBench emphasizes theorem-level TCS proof discovery, TCS-specific context repairs, and an offline library of cited prior work. It withholds source-paper lemmas and, for algorithm-design tasks, named constructions. Differences are in task inputs and pipeline design.
blocks.zh: 数学评价涉及准确答案数据集 (Cobbe等人,2021年;Hendrycks等人,2021年),困难或新问题和假真测试(Phan等人,2025年;Balunovic等人,2026年;Petrov等人,2025年),以及研究层次的问题。 (Glazer等人,2024年;Schmitt等人,2025年;Abouzaid等人,2026年a;Abouzaid等人,2026年b) 从竞争数学和发现(Hubert等人,2026年;Novikov等人,2025年;Feng等人,2026a年;Anthropic,2026b年;Alon等人,2026年)到甚至纳维埃-斯托克斯问题(OpenAI,2026年),以及所报告的正规化(Anthropic,2026a年),都取得了进步,促使人们进行系统的评价。 Lemma Bench从arXiv论文中提取自足的lemma,并支持反复更新(Peyronnet等人,2026年). 同时期的TCS-BENCH提供来自STOC,FOCS和SODA的300个自然语言任务,并配有基于依赖性的面具和专家评审(Cohen-Addad等人,2026年). 正规TCS提供经专家鉴定的自然语言和精益陈述和证明的例子(Wang等人,2026年)。 TCSAlg Bench强调定理级的TCS验证发现,TCS特有的上下文修复,以及被引用的前作的离线库. 它保留了源纸lemmas,对于算法设计任务,命名构造. 在任务投入和管道设计方面存在差异。

blocks.en: Proof agents combine iterative generation and critique ( Feng et al., 2026a ; An et al., 2026 ; Schmitt et al., 2026 ; Requena et al., 2026 ) , sketch-based decomposition ( Jiang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Varambally et al., ; Ren et al., 2025 ) , AND–OR or value-guided search ( Lample et al., 2022 ; Xin et al., 2025a ; Tsoukalas et al., 2026 ) , and replanning over dependency structures ( An et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) . General agent benchmarks emphasize versioned tasks, external evaluation, and resource accounting ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Theorem-dependency graphs support claim generation and retrieval ( Busbib and Werman, 2026 ; Kurgan et al., 2026 ) ; DeFAb benchmarks defeasible abduction ( Cooper and Velasquez, 2026 ) . Section 4.1 explains how workflows implemented in this work represent these mechanisms.

blocks.en: LLM judging has demonstrated substantial agreement with human judgments ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . For mathematical proofs, the Open Proof Corpus reports strong agreement with expert labels ( Dekoninck et al., 2026b ) , while ProofGrader improves scoring through reference solutions, rubrics, and ensembling ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . Pseudo-Formalization rewrites proofs into independently checked premise–conclusion modules, improving error-localization tradeoffs on competition and research proofs ( Barkallah et al., 2026 ) . TCS-BENCH supplies its judge with a reference proof ( Cohen-Addad et al., 2026 ) ; our pipeline checks cited statements against their sources before judging the submitted proof.

Pseudo-Formalization将证据重写成独立检查的前提-结论模块,改进竞争和研究证明的错误-本地化权衡(Barkallah等人,2026年)。 TCS-BENCH向其法官提供了一份证明文件(Cohen-Addad等人,2026年);我们的管道检查在判断提交的证据之前引用了与其来源相反的陈述。

blocks.en: Autoformalization spans early translation studies and paired corpora ( Wu et al., 2022 ; Azerbayev et al., 2023 ; Ying et al., 2024 ; Patel et al., 2023 ) , TCS collections ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026b ) , and textbook and research formalization ( Rammal et al., 2026 ; Moakhar et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . LeanDojo supports formal proof agents ( Yang et al., 2023 ) ; miniF2F and PutnamBench provide machine-checked evaluation ( Zheng et al., 2021 ; Tsoukalas et al., 2024 ) . Compilation does not ensure statement fidelity; model consensus is an imperfect, human-calibrated proxy ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) .

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark Scope and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 基准范围和评价

blocks.en: TCSAlgBench evaluates natural-language proof discovery for TCS claims involving algorithm design and sample- or runtime-complexity guarantees. It focuses on the stage of research after the problem and relevant literature have been identified by human researchers or other agents. We try to mimic the real research process, where human researchers propose a problem and provide previous work using their domain knowledge or other agents.
blocks.zh: TCSAlg Bench评价涉及算法设计和样本或运行时间复杂性担保的TCS索赔的自然语言证明发现。 其重点是问题发现后的研究阶段,以及相关的文献被人类研究者或其他代理人确定. 我们试图模仿真正的研究过程,人类研究人员在这里提出一个问题,并利用他们的领域知识或其他代理人提供之前的工作.

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Construction and Pipeline Development
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准建设和管道开发

blocks.en: The evaluation collection contains 398 challenges from 138 publicly available arXiv papers accepted to STOC and COLT 2026. Every challenge records its source and version. The public release includes challenges derived from arXiv versions licensed under CC BY 4.0 or CC0. A model-assisted screen retains papers whose main results give upper or lower bounds on sample or runtime complexity. The collection spans algorithmic fairness and calibration, differential privacy, learning theory, optimization, sampling, and other TCS areas, such as cryptography, graph theory, and coding theory. These areas underpin fair decision-making and calibrated prediction, privacy-preserving data analysis, learning from limited data, scalable optimization, and sampling for probabilistic inference. Cryptography, graph algorithms, and coding theory further support secure communication, routing and matching, and reliable data transmission. Our focus on sample and runtime complexity results tests a prerequisite for LLMs to contribute to such applications: reasoning about which computational improvements are achievable and at what cost. Upper-bound challenges can require constructing algorithms and proving their correctness and efficiency, while lower-bound challenges require establishing unavoidable limitations under explicit assumptions. These tasks examine whether models can support proposed methods with checkable arguments and identify constraints that human researchers must consider when assessing their usefulness.
blocks.zh: 评估汇编载有138份公开发表的ArXiv论文中的398项挑战,这些论文被STOC和COLT 2026所接受。 每个挑战都记录其来源和版本. 公开发布包括来自根据CC BY 4.0或CC0许可的arXiv版本的质疑. 模型辅助屏幕保留其主要结果在样本或运行时间复杂性上或下限的论文. 收集跨越了算法公平和校准,差分隐私,学习理论,优化,采样,以及其他TCS领域,如密码学,图表理论,编码理论. 这些领域是公平决策和校准预测、保护隐私数据分析、从有限数据中学习、可扩展优化以及概率推断抽样的基础。 密码学,图表算法,编码理论进一步支持安全通信,路由和匹配,以及可靠的数据传输. 我们注重抽样和运行时间复杂度的结果检验了有限责任公司促进这种应用的先决条件:说明哪些计算改进是可以实现的,成本如何。 上限挑战可能需要构建算法并证明其正确性和效率,而下限挑战则需要在明确的假设下确立不可避免的限制。 这些任务审查模型是否可以用可核查的论据支持拟议方法,并确定人类研究人员在评估其用途时必须考虑的制约因素。

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the construction pipeline, which uses Opus 4.8 with high reasoning mode. We resolve each source paper and the cited prior work needed to interpret it, parse the TeX sources into proof graphs of statements, definitions, and dependencies, and select one to four main theorems per source paper. Code assembles the selected source statements into a draft, and an LLM self-containment checker guides context completion.
blocks.zh: 图2总结了使用具有高推理模式的Opus 4.8的施工管道. 我们解决了每份源文件以及被引用的先前解释它所需的工作,将TeX源解析为声明,定义,和依赖性的证明图表,并选择每份源文件一到四个主要定理. 代码将选定的源语句组装成草稿,LLM自闭检查器上下文导完成.

blocks.en:
A central methodological contribution is our expert-designed repair layer, which bridges the gap between theorem extraction and fair, self-contained proof discovery. Applied automatically in a fixed sequence, its rules resolve internal references, recover rules governing information access and action order, harmonize notation, and remove intermediate results or construction details that expose the intended solution.
For example, when algorithm design is part of the task, a claim about “Algorithm 1” is rewritten as an existence claim that preserves its assumptions and quantitative guarantees. Mathematical context is quoted from the source, subject to notation normalization and these documented rewrites. Added standard-background definitions are explicitly labeled.
blocks.zh:
一个核心的方法贡献是我们专家设计的修复层,它弥合了定理提取与公平,自足的证明发现之间的差距. 以固定顺序自动应用,其规则解决内部引用,恢复关于信息访问和动作命令的规则,统一标记,并删除暴露预期解决方案的中间结果或构造细节.
例如,当算法设计是任务的一部分时,关于“算法1”的索赔被改写为保留其假设和定量保证的存在索赔。 数学上下文引自来源,但需经过注解正常化和这些文献记载的重写. 添加的标准背景定义有明确的标签.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Constructing proof-discovery challenges. The source proof graph is used only for selection. LLM checks guide source-text insertion to complete the context. Repair examples are schematic; existence rewrites preserve assumptions and quantitative guarantees when algorithm design is part of the task. Appendix B.3 details the construction passes.
blocks.zh: 图2:构建证明发现挑战. 源证明图仅用于选择. LLM检查指导源文本插入以完成上下文. 修补实例是图解;当算法设计是任务的一部分时,存在重写会保留假设和定量保证. 附录B.3详细列出了施工通行证。

blocks.en: We developed the extraction, context completion, and repair rules using 21 challenges across topics. After the final repair pass, we manually reviewed 61 challenge statements (these 21 development challenges and 40 additional challenges across topics) for fidelity and self-containment. All 40 additional challenges were judged faithful to the source results and self-contained. All headline model and workflow comparisons use the full collection of 398 challenges : the 61 reviewed statements, including the development set, and the remaining 337 challenges. Appendix B details construction, statement review, and source-date diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 我们利用21项跨专题挑战制定了提取、背景完成和修复规则。 最后修补合格后,我们手动审查了61项挑战声明(这21项发展挑战和40项跨专题的额外挑战),以保持忠诚和自我约束。 所有其他40项挑战都被认为忠实于来源结果和自成一体。 所有标题模式和工作流程比较都使用全部收集的398项挑战:61项经过审查的声明,包括开发套集,以及剩余的337项挑战。 附 录 B详细介绍了构建,声明审查,以及源日期诊断.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Proof-discovery evaluation interface. A challenge supplies the target theorem with its definitions, notation, assumptions, and problem setting. The offline sandbox permits access to cited prior work through the local prover graphs and the TeX file. The system returns one natural-language proof. Appendix A shows a complete challenge.
blocks.zh: 图3:证据发现评价界面. 一项挑战提供了目标定理的定义、标记、假设和问题设置。 离线沙盒允许通过本地验证图和TeX文件访问引用的前作. 系统返回一个自然语言的证明. 附 录 A显示了一个完全的挑战。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: A prover system receives a self-contained theorem statement with its definitions, assumptions, notation, and problem setting, and returns one proof in ordinary mathematical prose. The evaluator-controlled offline sandbox provides a fixed corpus of cited prior work through the local prover graphs, graph representations of those papers and their results. The prover may use results from this corpus. The source paper, its construction graph, and artifacts containing the target proof are excluded. Source-paper lemmas are neither supplied as additional facts nor inlined into the challenge; the prover must establish any such claims needed for its argument. The public release represents the cited documents through a versioned manifest of source URLs, versions, and checksums. Figure 3 illustrates this interface using the Calibeating challenge reproduced in full in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 一个验证系统收到一个自成一体的定理语句,带有它的定义,假设,注解和问题设置,并返回一个普通数学旁白中的证明. 评价员控制的离线沙盒通过当地证明人图表、这些文件的图表说明及其结果,提供了以前引用的固定工作资料。 证明人可能用到这本文书的结果。 不包括原始文件、其建筑图和载有目标证明的文物。 原始文件的lemma既未作为补充事实提供,也未融入质疑之中;证明人必须证实其论点所需的任何此类主张。 公开发布通过源代码URL、版本和校验和的版本表来代表引用的文件。 图3利用附录A全文转载的Calibeating挑战说明了这一接口。

blocks.en: Our primary outcome is verifier acceptance . Before scoring, a proof-organizing step checks whether statements cited from prior work match their original source statements. Three separately sampled GPT-5.5 high-effort voters receive only the problem statement and rewritten proof, with acceptance requiring at least two PASS votes. Internal verifier feedback guides search but does not determine the benchmark label. To assess sensitivity to the choice of judge, we re-score identical submissions with Opus 4.8 high effort. An author additionally reviewed 10 accepted proofs produced by GPT-5.5 xhigh through prover-verifier discussion on challenges in the manually reviewed statement set. All 10 accepted proofs were correct.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要结果就是核实接受。 评分前,一个校验组织步骤检查前作中引用的语句是否与其原始源语句相符. 三个单独抽样的GPT-5.5高功率选民只收到问题说明和重写证明,接受要求至少两张PASS选票. 内部核查员反馈指导搜索,但不确定基准标签. 为了评估对法官选择的敏感性,我们以4.8的高度努力重新评选相同的呈文。 一位作者通过对人工审查的成套说明中的挑战进行验证者讨论,对GPT-5.5xhigh提交的10份被接受的证明进行了额外审查。 所有10项证据都是正确的。

blocks.en: We report single-run acceptance (seed 1) and multi-run coverage , which counts a challenge once if any independently seeded run is accepted. The workflow comparison fixes the backbone model, problem input, and tool access, and matches model-call opportunities through shared limits on iterations, proof-goal attempts, and discussion rounds. The per-call generation limit is also fixed. Input and output tokens are reported separately because workflows can process different amounts of context within the same call budget. Section 4.1 describes the workflows, and Appendix C defines call accounting, outcome aggregation, and confidence scoring.
blocks.zh: 我们报告单跑接受率(种子1)和多跑覆盖率, 工作流程比较通过对重复、验证目标尝试和讨论回合的共同限制,确定主干模式、问题输入和工具访问,并匹配模式调用机会。 按呼号生成的限制也是固定的. 输入符和输出符是单独报告的,因为工作流程可以在同一个调用预算中处理不同数量的上下文. 第4.1节说明工作流程,附录C界定了呼叫会计、结果汇总和信心评分。

blocks.en: LLMs are commonly used for proof critique and automated assessment in recent mathematical reasoning systems and benchmarks, with evaluations against expert judgments supporting this practice ( Dekoninck et al., 2026b ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . Our proof-agent and verification prompts adapt BrokenMath ( Petrov et al., 2025 ) and QED ( An et al., 2026 ) , incorporating checks for false premises, unsupported citations, and unresolved proof obligations. Our rubric also shares criteria with concurrent TCS-BENCH ( Cohen-Addad et al., 2026 ) , including logical rigor, faithful use of assumptions and cited results, and quantitative correctness. Automated judging enables repeated comparisons on fresh, versioned batches, with a fixed judging protocol within each batch and targeted expert audits. Appendix C.1 summarizes the empirical evidence and protocol differences; Appendix E.2.2 provides our prompts.
blocks.zh: 在最近的数学推理系统和基准中,LLMs通常用于证据批评和自动评估,对专家判断的评价支持这种做法(Dekoninck等人,2026年b;Ma等人,2026年)。 我们的验证代理和核查提示调整了BrokenMath(Petrov等人,2025年)和QED(An等人,2026年),其中包含对虚假房地、无根据引用和未履行的举证义务的检查。 我们的标题也与同时存在的TCS-BENCH(Cohen-Addad等人,2026年)共享标准,包括逻辑严谨、忠实使用假设和引用结果以及定量正确性。 通过自动判断,可以对新鲜的、版本化的批次进行反复比较,在每个批次和有针对性的专家审计中都有固定的判断规程。 附录C.1概述了经验证据和协议差异;附录E.2.2提供了我们的提示。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Information flow in the four call-matched agent designs. Rightward arrows lead to a final proof on an internal stop or pass; red return arrows indicate retries. Final submissions are scored separately by the external verifier. Discussion reuses a shared history; root-only decomposition retries depth-1 reductions; MCTS searches a full AND–OR tree; and agentic planning revises a lemma DAG from critic feedback.
blocks.zh: 图4:四种调用匹配代理设计的信息流. 向右箭头导致在内部停留或通过时获得最终证明;红色返回箭头表示重复. 最后提交的材料由外部核查员单独打分。 讨论重用共享历史;仅根分解重试深度-1还原;MCTS搜索一整棵和-OR树;代理规划从批评者反馈中修改了lemma DAG.

blocks.en: 3.3 Provisional Lean Statements
blocks.zh: 3.3 临时精益声明

blocks.en: Formalizing selected TCS results is feasible, but broader coverage requires specialized definitions and supporting libraries ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Rammal et al., 2026 ) . As a supplementary result, we contribute a reusable statement-formalization pipeline for the community, producing candidate Lean 4 propositions in a pinned Mathlib/CSLib environment. Candidates must compile without sorry , admit , or untrusted axioms. Two checks require approval from both GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 high-effort reviewers: consistency with a back-translation generated without the challenge, and degeneracy checks for vacuous or trivial encodings. We retain 221 candidate statements (55.5% of 398 challenges) using our pipeline. Appendix B details construction and topic counts; Appendix D reports the results.
blocks.zh: 将选定的TCS结果正规化是可行的,但更广泛的覆盖面需要专门的定义和支持图书馆(Wang等人,2026年;Rammal等人,2026年)。 作为补充成果,我们为社区提供了可重复使用的陈述形式化管道,在封闭的Mathlib/CSLib环境中提出了候选的Lean 4命题。 候选人必须编译而无需道歉、承认或不信任的逻辑。 两项检查需要GPT-5.5和Opus 4.8高功率审查员的批准:与未遇到挑战而生成的反翻译一致,以及对空闲或微小编码的变性检查。 我们利用我们的管道保留了221份候选声明(398项挑战的55.5%)。 附 录 B详细介绍了建筑和主题计数;附录D报告了结果。

blocks.en: 4 Model and Agent Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4 模型和代理比较

blocks.en: We evaluate TCSAlgBench along two axes: model capability under common inference settings and agent design under matched model-call opportunities. After describing the experimental setup, we compare model configurations under direct inference and 10-round discussion, then compare four agent workflows using a fixed backbone model. We conclude the section with diagnostic analyses.
blocks.zh: 我们沿着两个轴线评估三氯环十二烷:在共同推论设置下的模型能力和在相应的模型调用机会下的代理人设计。 在描述实验设置后,在直接推论和10轮讨论下比较模型配置,然后使用固定主干模型比较四个代理工作流程. 我们以诊断分析结束这一节。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Sol at high, xhigh, and max effort, and GPT-5.5 and Fable 5 at high and xhigh. Each configuration is evaluated under direct inference and a simple 10-round prover–verifier discussion workflow. Direct inference uses the common proof prompt once, without critique or revision; discussion iteratively refines the proof using verifier feedback. We use ten independent runs for direct inference and five for discussion. All models are called through Amazon Bedrock with a 128K-token per-call output cap. We excluded Fable 5 max because of output-token access limits.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Opus 4.8和GPT-5.6 Sol在高、x高和最大努力,GPT-5.5和Fable 5在高和x高。 每个配置都通过直接推论和一个简单的10轮验证器-验证器讨论工作流程来评价. 直接推论使用常见的证明提示一次,没有批判或修改;讨论利用核查者的反馈反复完善证明. 我们用10个独立程序进行直接推论,5个用于讨论。 所有型号都通过亚马逊Bedrock使用128K-token每位调用输出盖来称呼. 我们排除了Fable 5最大,因为输出调试访问限制。

blocks.en: An agent workflow specifies how proving, verification, decomposition, and planning actions are coordinated in response to intermediate results. Using GPT-5.5 xhigh, we compare four workflows representing recurring proof-agent mechanisms (Figure 4 ). Iterative generation and critique motivate role-based discussion ( Feng et al., 2026a ; An et al., 2026 ; Schmitt et al., 2026 ) ; proof sketches and structured subgoals motivate root-only decomposition ( Jiang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Varambally et al., ) ; AND–OR search and value-guided exploration motivate decomposition with MCTS ( Lample et al., 2022 ; Xin et al., 2025a ; Tsoukalas et al., 2026 ) , with implementation details in Appendix C.2 ; and replanning with revisable lemma DAGs motivates agentic planning ( An et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) . These workflows abstract common mechanisms and implement them using shared prover and verifier prompts, enabling a fair comparison of agent designs with a fixed backbone model and matched model-call opportunities. We use GPT-5.5 xhigh because its earlier knowledge cutoff leaves a larger subset of challenges published after the cutoff.
blocks.zh: 代理工作流程规定如何根据中间结果协调证明、核查、分解和规划行动。 使用GPT-5.5xhigh,我们比较了代表反复出现的验证代理机制的四个工作流程(图4 ). 催生和批评激发基于角色的讨论(冯等人,2026a); An等人, 2026年;Schmitt等人, 2026年), 证明草图和结构化的次级目标激励仅根分解(Jiang等人, 2022年;Zhang等人, 2023年;Varambally等人, 2026年;和-OR搜索和价值指导的勘探激励与MCTS分解(Lample等人, 2022年;Xin等人, 2025a年;Tsoukalas等人, 2026年), 附录C.2详细执行情况; 重新规划可复制的lemma DAG激励剂规划(An等人, 2026年;Wu等人, 2026年;Chung等人, 2026年)。 这些工作流程采用抽象的共同机制,并利用共享的验证器和验证器提示来实施,从而能够将代理设计与固定主干模型进行公平比较,并匹配模式调用机会。 我们使用GPT-5.5xhigh,因为其早期的知识截断留下了在截断后公布的更大子集的挑战.

blocks.en: Each workflow uses five independent runs with up to 20 outer iterations per run, matched model-call opportunities and per-call limits, and the same external verifier. This experiment therefore differs from the model comparison in both its discussion protocol and its search budget. Appendix C details the workflows, budgets, and scoring rules. Our GPT-5.5 xhigh agent with agentic planning achieves higher five-run coverage than GPT-5.6 Sol max with discussion and repeated sampling, demonstrating the effectiveness of our agent implementation.
blocks.zh: 每个工作流程使用5个独立运行,每个运行最多20个外迭,匹配模式调用机会和每个调用限制,以及相同的外部验证器. 因此,这一试验与其讨论程序和搜索预算的模型比较不同。 附 录 C详细介绍了工作流程,预算和评分规则. 我们具有代理规划的GPT-5.5x高药剂的五运行覆盖率高于GPT-5.6。 最多有讨论和反复取样,表明我们代理剂执行的有效性。

blocks.en: 4.2 The Benchmark Separates Model Configurations
blocks.zh: 4.2 基准分离模式配置

blocks.en: Fable 5 leads direct inference: xhigh has the highest seed-1 acceptance (6.8%), while high has the highest ten-run coverage (14.6%). Under 10-round discussion, GPT-5.6 Sol max achieves the highest seed-1 acceptance (18.8%) and five-run coverage (23.6%). This change in ordering shows that model comparisons depend on how inference is organized. Even the strongest configuration leaves more than three-quarters of the benchmark uncovered after five discussion runs (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 寓言5引领直接推论:xhigh拥有最高的种子-1接受率(6.8%),而最高的10跑覆盖率(14.6%). 在10轮讨论中,GPT-5.6 Sol max实现了最高的种子-1接受率(18.8%)和5跑覆盖率(23.6%). 订单的这一变化表明模型比较取决于如何组织推断. 即使最强的配置也留下了经过五次讨论后发现的基准的四分之三以上(图5).

blocks.en: Figure 5: Verifier acceptance on all 398 challenges under the three-voter majority rule. Blue bars show seed 1; red bars show coverage over 10 direct-inference runs (a) or five 10-round discussion runs (b). Labels give percentages. Rows are grouped by model family and ordered within each family by coverage; Tables 3 and 4 give detailed results.
blocks.zh: 图5:根据三票多数规则对所有398项质疑的确认接受。 蓝条显示种子1;红条显示覆盖范围超过10个直接推论跑(a)或5个10轮讨论跑(b). 标签给出百分比。 表3和表4列出了详细结果。

blocks.en: We compare ten independent direct-inference runs with one 10-round discussion run, allocating proof-generation attempts to independent sampling or successive revisions. One discussion run outperforms ten-run direct coverage for all eight GPT and Opus configurations: Sol max reaches 18.8% versus 13.8%, and GPT-5.5 xhigh reaches 11.3% versus 7.0%. Fable 5 is the sole exception: ten-run direct coverage reaches 14.6% and 11.3% for high and xhigh, respectively, compared with 9.3% and 9.5% for one discussion run (Tables 3 and 4 ). These results suggest that feedback-guided revision can be more productive than repeatedly starting from scratch, while the effective allocation of inference attempts depends on the model. Independent restarts remain useful after multi-round discussion. Five discussion runs increase coverage from 18.8% to 23.6% for Sol max and from 11.3% to 18.1% for GPT-5.5 xhigh. Thus, a single refinement trajectory leaves substantial additional coverage accessible through other seeds. Together, these observations motivate combining prover–verifier feedback with multiple independent starts.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了10项独立的直接推论和10轮讨论,将产生证据的努力用于独立的抽样或连续的修订。 一次讨论超越了所有8个GPT和Opus配置的10次直接覆盖: 溶液最大值为18.8%对13.8%,GPT-5.5x高值为11.3%对7.0%. 第5条是唯一的例外:10条直接覆盖的高低和高低分别达到14.6%和11.3%,而一次讨论的覆盖率分别为9.3%和9.5%(表3和表4)。 这些结果表明,以反馈为指南的修订可能比从零开始的反复修订更有成果,而有效分配推断尝试则取决于模型。 经过多轮讨论后,独立重启依然有用。 有五次讨论将Sol max的覆盖率从18.8%提高到23.6%,GPT-5.5xhigh的覆盖率从11.3%提高到18.1%。 因此,单一的精细轨迹使得通过其他种子可以获得大量的额外覆盖。 这些观测结果共同促使验证者反馈与多个独立开始相结合。

blocks.en: Higher effort does not uniformly improve coverage. Fable 5 high covers 58 challenges across ten direct-inference runs, versus 45 for xhigh, despite averaging 46K rather than 62K output tokens per call. Under five-run discussion, Sol xhigh and max share 78 accepted challenges, with 10 unique to xhigh and 16 unique to max (Table 7 ). These complementary coverage sets suggest that varying effort can expose alternative successful approaches; simply choosing the highest effort does not subsume the results of lower settings.
blocks.zh: 加大工作力度并不能统一提高覆盖率。 5号线高点涵盖10个直接推论中的58个挑战,x高点为45个,尽管平均每次调用46K而不是62K个产出符号。 在五轮讨论下,Sol xhigh和Max分享78项被接受的挑战,其中10项为xhigh独有,16项为最大独有(表7)。 这些补充的涵盖范围表明,不同的努力可能暴露出其他的成功办法;仅仅选择最高的努力并不包含较低环境的结果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Agent Design Changes Effectiveness and Cost
blocks.zh: 4.3 代理设计变化的有效性和成本

(b) Input and output tokens averaged over 10 randomly selected challenges and five independent seeds; M denotes millions. Rows follow five-run coverage. Workflows share call opportunities and per-call generation limits, but token usage differs. Table 8 gives exact counts and budget details.

blocks.en: We compare four agent workflows using GPT-5.5 xhigh under matched model-call opportunities (Figure 6 ). Only final assembled proofs contribute to acceptance.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了四个使用GPT-5.5x高的代理工作流程,在匹配的模型调用机会下(图6). 只有最后组装的证据才有助于接受。

blocks.en: Root-only decomposition increases seed-1 acceptance from 15.1% to 18.3% and five-run coverage from 21.1% to 23.4% relative to discussion without decomposition. These gains suggest that organizing a proof around explicit intermediate claims helps the model make progress. The quality of the decomposition matters: its subgoals must be easier to establish and jointly sufficient to prove the target theorem. Identifying such intermediate claims is itself a substantive reasoning task, making decomposition an important part of proof discovery. MCTS achieves the highest seed-1 acceptance (19.3%), but its five-run coverage exceeds root-only decomposition by only three challenges (96 versus 93). One possible bottleneck is the quality of the LLM-generated scores used to guide search: the model may not be sufficiently calibrated to assess promising subproblems in these proof tasks.
blocks.zh: 根单质分解使种子-1接受率从15.1%提高到18.3%,与未分解的讨论相比,五跑覆盖率从21.1%提高到23.4%. 这些进展表明,围绕明确的中间索赔组织证据有助于模型取得进展。 分解事项的质量:其次级目标必须更容易确定,并共同足以证明目标定理. 确定这种中间索赔本身就是一项实质性推理任务,使分解成为证据发现的一个重要部分。 MCTS实现了最高的种子-1接受率(19.3%),但其5个运行覆盖率仅以3个挑战(96对93)超过了仅根分解. 一种可能的瓶颈是用于指导搜索的LLM生成的分数的质量:该模型可能不足以校准以评估这些证明任务中有希望的子问题.

blocks.en: Agentic planning achieves higher five-run coverage than MCTS (25.4% versus 24.1%), although its seed-1 acceptance is lower (18.1% versus 19.3%). The planner proposes decompositions globally, considering how the subgoals and their dependencies fit together to prove the target theorem. This global view may produce more coherent decompositions and help explain its broader coverage. In the token sample, planning averages 60.4M input and 9.0M output tokens per run, versus 27.4M and 3.9M for MCTS. The global plan provides more proof targets to explore from the outset, which may help explain the higher token consumption under matched call opportunities.
blocks.zh: 代理规划的五运行覆盖率高于MCTS(25.4%对24.1%),尽管其种子-1接受率较低(18.1%对19.3%)。 规划者提议在全球范围进行分解,同时考虑到次级目标及其依赖性如何结合在一起,以证明目标定理。 这种全球观点可能会产生更一致的分解,并有助于解释其更广泛的覆盖范围. 在标志性样本中,规划的平均输入量为60.4M,每跑9.0M,而MCTS为27.4M和3.9M. 全球计划从一开始就提供了更多的证明指标以供探讨,这可能有助于解释在相应呼叫机会下较高的象征性消费。

blocks.en: 4.4 Diagnostic Analyses and Broader Uses
blocks.zh: 4.4 诊断分析和更广泛的用途

The eight shared model configurations retain their five-run coverage ordering, with count changes of − 6 -6 to + 2 +2 (Table 5 ). Under the GPT-5.5 three-voter majority rule versus the Opus 4.8 verifier, five-run coverage is 101 versus 103 challenges for planning, 93 versus 96 for root-only decomposition, 84 versus 72 for discussion, and 96 versus 84 for MCTS. Both verifiers support our conclusion that MCTS offers no clear advantage over root-only decomposition.

There is no consistent pre-cutoff advantage.

blocks.en: Beyond evaluating mathematical proof performance, TCSAlgBench may support broader studies of model behavior. For example, comparing challenge-level overlap across effort settings could help investigate how additional inference effort changes coverage, as suggested by the complementary Sol xhigh and max results. Fable 5 xhigh’s higher direct-inference token use and smaller seed-1 gain from discussion than Sol max could motivate studies of how model-specific prompting or internal refinement interacts with external critique. Source-date partitions and fresh challenge batches could also support investigations of possible training exposure. These examples illustrate potential diagnostic uses of the benchmark and directions for future study.
blocks.zh: 除了评价数学证明性能之外,TCSAlg Bench可能支持对模型行为的更广泛的研究. 例如,如补充的Sol xhigh和最大结果所示,比较不同工作环境的挑战层面重叠有助于调查额外推断努力如何改变覆盖面。 与Sol Max相比, 源数据分割和新的挑战批次也可支持对可能的培训风险的调查。 这些例子说明了今后研究的基准和方向的潜在诊断用途。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced TCSAlgBench, a benchmark and reusable pipeline for natural-language proof discovery in theoretical computer science. Its 398 challenges combine source context with expert-designed repairs for notation, interaction rules, and algorithm-design tasks. GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Fable 5 demonstrate promising capabilities on these research-level tasks, with GPT models benefiting substantially from prover–verifier discussion. Our results identify prover–verifier discussion and repeated sampling as effective ways to improve coverage. In the workflow comparison using GPT-5.5, root-only decomposition provides further gains at a substantially lower token cost than agentic planning. When maximizing coverage takes priority over token cost, agentic planning achieves the highest five-run coverage among the tested workflows. Together, these findings highlight model capability and workflow design as complementary directions for improving automated TCS proof discovery.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了TCSAlg Bench,作为理论计算机科学中自然语言验证发现的基准和可重复使用的管道. 它的398项挑战结合了源背景和专家设计的修复,用于标记,交互规则,以及算法设计任务. GPT-5.5、GPT-5.6 Sol和Fable 5显示了在这些研究一级任务方面很有希望的能力,GPT模型在很大程度上受益于验证员的讨论。 我们的结果显示,验证员的讨论和重复抽样是扩大覆盖面的有效途径。 在使用GPT-5.5进行的工作流程比较中,仅根分解以比代理规划低得多的象征性成本提供了进一步的收益. 当尽量扩大覆盖面比象征性成本优先时,代理规划在经过测试的工作流程中实现了最高的五运行覆盖. 这些结论共同突出了模型能力和工作流程设计是改进自动TCS验证发现的补充方向.

blocks.en: B.1 Source Papers and Problem Selection
blocks.zh: B.1 原始文件和问题选择

blocks.en: The current candidate pool consists of papers accepted to STOC 2026 and COLT 2026 with public arXiv versions. We retrieve papers through the arXiv API and retain their TeX sources. Future candidate pools also require public arXiv sources and public releases additionally require CC BY 4.0 or CC0 licensing for the exact version used.
blocks.zh: 目前的候选人才库包括接受STOC 2026和COLT 2026的论文,并有公开的arXiv版本. 我们通过ARXIV API获取文件 并保留他们的TeX来源。 未来的候选人才库还需要公开的arXiv来源,公开发布还需要CC BY 4.0或CC0对使用的确切版本颁发许可证.

blocks.en: A model-assisted screen retains papers whose main results give upper or lower bounds on sample or runtime complexity and assigns each paper one primary area: algorithmic fairness and calibration, differential privacy, learning theory, optimization, sampling, or Other . The last category includes graph and dynamic algorithms, quantum computing and information, coding theory, lattice-based cryptography, and fine-grained complexity or hardness of approximation. Within each paper, we select nontrivial theorem-level claims that can be made self-contained at moderate length.
blocks.zh: 模型辅助屏幕保留了其主要结果在样本或运行时间复杂度上下界限的论文,并为每份文件分配了一个主要领域:算法公平和校准、差异隐私、学习理论、优化、取样或其他。 最后一类包括图表和动态算法,量子计算和信息,编码理论,基于纹理的密码学,以及近似的细纹复杂度或硬度. 在每份文件中,我们选择非三角定理级的主张,这些主张可以适度长度地自成一体.

blocks.en: B.2 Proof-Graph Construction
blocks.zh: B.2 证明-格拉夫建筑

blocks.en: We use TeX sources to preserve theorem environments, labels, mathematical notation, and cross-references. A model pass identifies cited works available on arXiv, and a verifier checks for omissions before the references are resolved to TeX files. The source paper and resolved references are then converted into proof-dependency graphs.
blocks.zh: 我们使用TeX源来保存定理环境,标签,数学标记,以及交叉引用. 一个模型传球识别了arXiv上可用的引用作品,并在解析引用到TeX文件之前对遗漏进行核查. 源文件和已解决的参考文献随后被转换成证明依赖性图表.

blocks.en: Each numbered statement becomes a node containing its printed label, kind, verbatim statement, assumptions, free variables, and direct proof when present. A second pass records direct invocations of other result nodes as dependency edges. A glossary stores paper-specific terms, aliases, named objects, operators, functions, interaction rules, and algorithms with their verbatim definitions, excluding standard textbook background. Code attaches each glossary entry to nodes whose statements use its term or alias.
blocks.zh: 每个编号的语句成为节点,包含其打印的标签,类型,逐字记录,假设,自由变量,以及在场时的直接证明. 第二次通行记录直接引用其他结果节点作为依赖边缘. 术语表存储了纸质特定术语,别名,命名对象,运算符,函数,交互规则,以及算法及其逐字记录定义,不包括标准教科书背景. 代码将每个词汇条目附加到其语句使用其术语或别名的节点上.

blocks.en: Deterministic checks enforce label consistency, absence of dangling references, and acyclicity; structural errors trigger regeneration. A semantic audit flags missed statements, mislabeled results, informal restatements, and suspicious dependencies for review. Untrusted cyclic or dangling edges are dropped and recorded. The source paper’s graph is used only for challenge selection and is withheld from the prover; evaluation provides access to cited prior work through its graphs and TeX files.
blocks.zh: 决定性检查强制标签的一致性,缺少折叠的引用,以及循环;结构错误触发再生. 一面语义审计旗错过了声明,错误标注的结果,非正式的重复,以及可疑的依赖性以供审查. 无人信任的自行车或拖曳边被放下并记录下来. 源文件的图表仅用于质疑选择,不用于证明人;评价通过其图表和TeX文件提供前述工作的访问.

blocks.en: Each challenge contains a target theorem and the context needed to understand it, with the target proof withheld. Figure 2 gives an overview. The ten passes below are grouped into three phases; passes 2–10 apply expert-designed repair rules automatically in the stated order. Appendix E.1.2 provides representative prompts.

This loop stops at a fixed round limit or when no new context can be added; gaps without a suitable entry remain recorded for later repair.

blocks.en: B.4 Statement Review and Versioning
blocks.zh: B.4 报表审查和版本

blocks.en: We developed the extraction, context-completion, repair, and self-containment rules using 21 challenges across topics. After the final repair pass, we manually reviewed 61 statements for fidelity and self-containment: the 21 development challenges and 40 additional challenges. All 40 additional challenges were judged faithful to the source results and self-contained. Headline model and agent comparisons use all 398 challenges, including the development challenges.
blocks.zh: 我们利用21项跨主题挑战,制定了提取、背景完成、修复和自我约束规则。 在最后的修理证通过之后,我们人工审查了61份关于忠诚和自我娱乐的声明:21项发展挑战和40项额外挑战。 所有其他40项挑战都被认为忠实于来源结果和自成一体。 头条模式和代理人比较使用所有398项挑战,包括发展挑战。

blocks.en: New releases add versioned batches while preserving prior evaluation sets. Future batches can draw on newly released papers, including FOCS and SODA papers, using the same construction and validation pipeline. Each release records new and unchanged challenges and their evaluation splits.
blocks.zh: 新版在保留先前的评价套件的同时添加了版本的批次. 未来批次可以借鉴新发行的论文,包括FOCS和SODA论文,使用相同的建造和验证管道. 每次发布都记录了新的和未变的挑战,其评价也各自为政.

blocks.en: We record each challenge’s first arXiv version date and partition results by assumed model-family knowledge cutoffs. This is a coarse diagnostic: publication dates alone cannot rule out contamination. Appendix D.2 reports the source-date results.
blocks.zh: 我们记录每个挑战的第一个arXiv版本日期, 这是一个粗糙的诊断:仅仅公布日期不能排除污染。 附录D.2报告了来源日期的结果。

blocks.en: B.5 Provisional Lean Statement Construction
blocks.zh: B.5 临时利恩声明建设

blocks.en: A GPT-5.5 xhigh formalization agent receives the self-contained challenge and a Mathlib/CSLib API guide and writes a def name_statement : Prop declaration, adding minimal local definitions where needed. Declarations must compile in the pinned Lean environment without sorry , admit , or untrusted axioms.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.5x高正规化代理接受自成一体的挑战, 提倡宣布,必要时增加最低限度的当地定义. 声明必须编集在坚固的利恩环境中,

blocks.en: Compilation alone cannot establish fidelity. A separate GPT-5.5 high-effort call back-translates the Lean statement into natural language without seeing the source statement. The consistency gate (C) compares the challenge with this back-translation, checking hypotheses, quantifiers, conclusions, bounds, and boundary cases; its jurors do not see the Lean code. The degeneracy gate (D) receives the challenge and Lean code and checks for vacuous assumptions, trivial witnesses, degenerate Mathlib values, and other ways to satisfy the encoding without the intended mathematical content.
blocks.zh: 仅靠汇编不能确定忠诚。 一个单独的GPT-5.5高音调将Lean语句反译为自然语言,而不见源语句. 一致性门(C)将挑战与这种反译比较,检查假说,限定词,结论,界限,和边界案件;其陪审员不见利恩码. degeneracy gate(D)接收质疑和精益密码,并检查空虚的假设,细微的见证,退化的Mathlib值,以及满足编码而无预定数学内容的其他方法.

blocks.en: Each gate uses three GPT-5.5 high-effort and three Opus 4.8 high-effort jurors. Acceptance requires at least two yes votes within each model family on both gates. Jurors are stateless and see neither earlier reviews nor one another’s judgments; parsing failures and call errors count as no votes. If exactly one family fails a gate by one vote, its three-juror panel is resampled once for that gate and turn, retaining whichever panel has more yes votes. The acceptance rule is then reapplied.
blocks.zh: 每个门使用3个GPT-5.5高功率和3个Opus 4.8高功率陪审员. 在两座大门上,每个模范家庭至少需要两张赞成票。 陪审员是无国籍的,既不看以前的审查,也不看对方的判决;分析失败和调用错误算作没有选票。 如果一个家庭以一票之差不能进入一个大门,则其三分之一的小组将重新为该大门作一次模拟,然后转弯,保留获得更多赞成票的小组。 然后重新适用接受规则。

blocks.en: The agent receives up to five rounds of generation and review, stopping on acceptance. After failed reviews, dissent guides revision of the best candidate so far, ranked first by gates passed and then by total yes votes. The pipeline retains 221 compiler-valid candidates from 398 challenges (55.5%); Table 1 reports retention by topic.
blocks.zh: 该剂最多接收五轮生成和审查,接受后停止. 在审查失败后,持不同政见者指导对迄今最佳候选人的修订,先按门类通过排名,然后按赞成票总数排名。 管道保留了来自398项挑战(55.5%)的221个编译器有效候选人;表1按主题报告保留情况。

blocks.en: Table 1: Candidate Lean-statement retention by topic after compilation and automated semantic filtering. The rows follow the topic order used in Table 4 . Retention is a construction diagnostic, not expert-validated formalization accuracy.
blocks.zh: 表1:按编译和自动语义过滤后的专题分列的候选人精益陈述保留。 各行遵循表4中所使用的主题顺序。 保留是一种构造诊断,而不是专家鉴定的正式化精度.

blocks.en: Appendix C Evaluation Protocol Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价协议

blocks.en: This appendix describes external verification, repeated-run metrics, and diagnostic procedures. All headline model and agent acceptance comparisons use the full collection of 398 challenges.
blocks.zh: 本附录介绍外部核查、重复运行的计量和诊断程序。 所有头条模型和代理接受比较都使用全集398项挑战.

blocks.en: C.1 External Verification and Author Inspection
blocks.zh: C.1 外部核查和作者检查

blocks.en: Each system submits one final natural-language proof. Before external verification, a proof-organizing step checks whether statements cited from prior work match their original source statements. Three separately sampled GPT-5.5 high-effort voters receive only the problem statement and rewritten proof and return PASS or FAIL with a rationale. At least two PASS votes are required for acceptance. A system’s internal verifier is part of the workflow being evaluated and never contributes to the benchmark label.
blocks.zh: 每个系统都提交一份最后的自然语言证明。 在外部核查之前,一个验证组织步骤检查先前工作引用的语句是否与其原始源语句相符. 三个单独抽样的GPT-5.5高功率选民只收到问题说明和重写证明,并带着理由返回PASS或FAIL. 接受选举至少需要两张PASS的选票。 一个系统的内部核查员是正在评价的工作流程的一部分,从来不有助于基准标签。

blocks.en: An author reviewed 10 accepted proofs produced by GPT-5.5 xhigh through prover–verifier discussion on challenges in the 61-problem manually reviewed statement set. All 10 accepted proofs were correct. We also re-score identical submissions with an alternative Opus 4.8 high-effort verifier. Section 4.4 reports the resulting coverage counts and changes in ordering.
blocks.zh: 一位作者审查了GPT-5.5 x high通过证明人-核查人关于61个问题手动审查的成套说明中质疑的论述而提出的10份被接受的证据。 所有10项证据都是正确的。 我们还对相同的呈文进行重新评分,另加一个Opus 4.8高功率核查器。 第4.4节报告由此产生的覆盖范围和订单变化。

blocks.en: BrokenMath reports 95% agreement with human annotations on 250 responses to false mathematical statements ( Petrov et al., 2025 ) . QED combines separate prover and verifier calls with staged structural and detailed checks, producing expert-verified proofs for three open research problems ( An et al., 2026 ) . Following prompt optimization, concurrent TCS-BENCH reports over 90% accuracy against expert judgments on 100 human-labeled proofs ( Cohen-Addad et al., 2026 ) . Reported agreement depends on the task and judging protocol, including TCS-BENCH’s access to a reference proof; it does not directly validate our statement-and-proof-only verifier.
blocks.zh: BrokenMath报告说,95%的人同意对虚假数学陈述的250个答复(Petrov等人,2025年)。 QED将独立的验证器和验证器的调用与分阶段的结构和详细检查相结合,为三个开放的研究问题产生专家验证的证明(An等人,2026年). 在迅速优化之后,TCS-BENCH同时报告,根据专家对100份人类标记证明的判断,准确度超过90%(Cohen-Addad等人,2026年)。 报告的协议取决于任务和判断协议,包括TCS-BENCH获得参考证明;它不能直接验证我们的陈述和唯一防伪的核查人。

blocks.en: C.2 Agent Workflow Definitions
blocks.zh: C.2 代理工作流程定义

blocks.en: We compare four workflows using GPT-5.5 xhigh, drawing on recurring proof-agent mechanisms ( Thakur et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Chung et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Tsoukalas et al., 2026 ) . Figure 4 summarizes their information flow.
blocks.zh: 我们利用反复出现的验证剂机制,利用GPT-5.5 x high比较了四个工作流程(Thakur等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2023年;Chung等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年b年;Liu等人,2026年a年;Zhang等人,2026年a年;Tsoukalas等人,2026年). 图4概述了它们的信息流动情况。

blocks.en: A decider, prover, and verifier share a bounded discussion history. The prover revises its argument using verifier feedback, without explicit decomposition ( Feng et al., 2026a ; An et al., 2026 ; Schmitt et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Huang and Yang, 2025 ; Balko et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 一个决定者、证明者和核查者共享一个有限的讨论历史。 证明人使用核查器反馈修改其论点,而不明确分解(Feng等人,2026a); An等人,2026年;Schmitt等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年;Huang and Yang,2025年;Balko等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Each attempt creates one depth-1 dependency-aware lemma plan, proves its subgoals, and recombines them. After failure, the workflow requests a new root-level plan ( Jiang et al., 2022 ; Corneli, 2026 ; Varambally et al., ) .
blocks.zh: 每一次尝试都会产生一个深度-1的依赖性-意识lemma计划,证明它的次级目标,并重新组合它们. 失败后,工作流程要求一个新的根层计划(Jiang等人,2022年;Corneli,2026年;Varambally等人,).

blocks.en: The search maintains an AND–OR tree of proof goals ( Kung et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . An OR-node represents a goal that can be established by an accepted direct proof or a successful decomposition. An AND-node represents a decomposition whose child claims must all be established. Nodes track their search status, estimated value, importance, visit count, and attempt history. At a selected open goal, a decider coordinates proof, disproof, or expansion attempts through the prover–verifier loop. Proposed reductions undergo checks for variable scope, assumptions, and non-triviality, followed by verification of their recombination arguments before attachment to the tree.
blocks.zh: 搜索中保持了AND-OR的证明目标(Kung等人,2026年;Wang等人,2024年). 一个OR-节点代表着一个可以通过接受的直接证明或成功分解而确定的目标. AND-node代表一个分解体,其儿童诉求必须全部确定. 节点跟踪其搜索状态,估计值,重要性,访问计数,以及尝试历史. 在选定的开放目标上,一个决定者通过验证者-验证者循环来协调证明、解密或扩展尝试。 提议的削减要经过对可变范围、假设和非三重性的检查,然后在树上附着之前核实其重新组合的理由。

blocks.en: Selection uses estimated values ( Lample et al., 2022 ; Xin et al., 2025a ; Hubert et al., 2026 ) . We collect open goals along promising decomposition paths and, when they exceed the per-iteration limit, rank them by importance-weighted upper confidence bounds: score ⁡ ( v ) = i ⁡ ( v ) ​ [ q ^ ​ ( v ) + c ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ref ) 1 + n ⁡ ( v ) ] , \operatorname{score}(v)=i(v)\left[\widehat{q}(v)+c\sqrt{\frac{\log(1+n_{\mathrm{ref}})}{1+n(v)}}\right], where n ⁡ ( v ) n(v) is the visit count of goal v v , n ref n_{\mathrm{ref}} is the total visit count across candidate goals, c c controls exploration, and i ⁡ ( v ) i(v) represents the goal’s share of the root’s proof difficulty. The root has importance one. For each new decomposition, an LLM assigns normalized difficulty shares to its children, which inherit their parent’s importance multiplicatively. Failed importance calls use uniform shares.

blocks.en: The evaluator assesses completeness κ ⁡ ( v ) \kappa(v) , the importance-weighted fraction of difficulty already closed by proved or dead parts, and solvability, the estimated likelihood of closing the remaining work. Its search value is q ^ ​ ( v ) = s ​ ( v ) ​ 1 + κ ⁡ ( v ) 2 , \widehat{q}(v)=s(v)\,\frac{1+\kappa(v)}{2}, where s ⁡ ( v ) s(v) is the solvability estimate.
blocks.zh: 评估人员评估了 & & (v)\kappa(v) 的完备性、经证明或已死亡部分解决的困难的重要加权部分以及可溶性、结束剩余工作的估计可能性。 它的搜索值为 q ^ (v) = s (v) 1 + κ (v) 2,\glasshat {q} (v) = s (v)\\,\ frac{ 1}\ kappa(v)\2},其中 s → (v) s (v) 是可溶性估计.

blocks.en: After each iteration, outcomes and refreshed values propagate through the ancestors, and visit counts increase. Proved subgoals redistribute their importance among still-open siblings. If any child becomes dead, its decomposition becomes dead and that decomposition’s subgoal importances become zero. Search continues until the root closes or the budget in Appendix C.3 is exhausted. The assembled proof receives separate external verification.
blocks.zh: 每次迭代后,结果和新鲜价值通过祖先传播,访问次数增加。 已证实的次级目标在仍然开放的兄弟姐妹中重新分配其重要性。 如果有任何儿童死亡,其分解就会死,分解的次级目标的重要性就变为零。 搜索持续到根关闭或附录C.3中的预算耗尽. 组装的证据接受单独的外部核查。

blocks.en: A planner constructs and revises a lemma DAG while coordinating decomposition, subgoal proving, critique, and recombination. After a failed attempt, it receives failure feedback and the current proof state to revise the DAG ( An et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Kripner and Straka, 2026 ; Xin et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 规划人员在协调分解、次级目标证明、批评和重组的同时,构筑和修改lemma DAG。 在尝试失败后,它收到故障反馈和当前修改DAG的证明状态(An等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年;Kripner和Straka,2026年;Xin等人,2025年b).

blocks.en: For decomposition-based workflows, only the final recombined proof contributes to acceptance. We record reduction validity, whether subgoals are simpler than the root theorem, which subgoals are accepted, and recombination soundness to distinguish failures of planning, subproblem solving, and assembly.
blocks.zh: 对于基于分解的工作流程,只有最后的重新组合的证明才有助于接受. 我们记录减少有效性,子目标是否比根定理更简单,接受哪个子目标,并重新组合稳健,以区别规划失败,次问题解决和组装.

blocks.en: C.3 Budgets and Reporting
blocks.zh: C.3 预算和报告

blocks.en: All runs use the fixed offline corpus and access restrictions in Section 3.2 , with a 128K-token per-call output cap. The public release represents cited documents through a versioned manifest.
blocks.zh: 所有运行都使用第3.2节的固定离线装置和出入限制,每个呼叫输出上限为128K。 公开发布代表了通过版本清单引用的文件。

blocks.en: The model comparison pairs single-call direct inference with 10-round prover–verifier discussion. The separate agent comparison fixes GPT-5.5 xhigh, problem input, tool access, and the external verifier, and matches model-call opportunities across workflows. Each challenge–seed run permits at most 20 outer iterations, with up to six proof goals attempted in parallel and at most 10 discussion rounds per goal within each iteration. Calls by every role count toward the budget.
blocks.zh: 模型比较将单调直接推论与10轮验证器–验证器讨论对齐. 单独的代理比较可以修正GPT-5.5x高,问题输入,工具访问,以及外部验证器,并匹配跨工作流程的模型调用机会. 每个挑战 - 种子最多在20个外迭上运行许可,最多有6个证明目标同时尝试,每个外迭内最多10个讨论回合。 每一个角色的呼吁都算在预算上。

blocks.en: Seed-1 acceptance is the fraction of the 398 challenges accepted in the first run. Multi-run coverage counts a challenge once if any independently seeded run is accepted. Direct inference uses ten runs; model-comparison discussion and the agent workflows each use five runs.
blocks.zh: 种子-1接受是第一轮接受的398项挑战中的一小部分. 如果接受任何独立的种子运行,多运行覆盖就构成挑战。 直接推论使用10跑;模型比较讨论和代理工作流程各使用5跑.

blocks.en: Calibration uses a separate run for each model on all 398 challenges. Each model reports confidence p i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] p_{i}\in[0,1] during proof generation, before external evaluation; we pair it with that proof’s acceptance label. Following Humanity’s Last Exam ( Phan et al., 2025 ) , we compute root mean square calibration error from confidence bins B 1 , … , B K B_{1},\ldots,B_{K} : RMSCE = ∑ k = 1 K | B k | N ​ ( acc ⁡ ( B k ) − conf ⁡ ( B k ) ) 2 . \operatorname{RMSCE}=\sqrt{\sum_{k=1}^{K}\frac{|B_{k}|}{N}\left(\operatorname{acc}(B_{k})-\operatorname{conf}(B_{k})\right)^{2}}. Here N = 398 N=398 , acc ⁡ ( B k ) \operatorname{acc}(B_{k}) is the bin’s verifier-acceptance rate, and conf ⁡ ( B k ) \operatorname{conf}(B_{k}) is its mean reported confidence. We use the released implementation with p = 2 p=2 and β = 40 \beta=40 . Table 9 reports acceptance and calibration from these same runs; calibration targets individual-proof acceptance, not union-of-runs coverage.

RMSCE}=\sqrt{\ssumsum_{k = 1}^{K}\frac{|B_{k}|}{N}\left(\operatorname{ac}(B_{k})-\operatorname{conf}(B_{k})\right =2}}. 在此 N = 398 N = 398, acc (B k)\operatorname{ac}(B_{k})是 bin 的验证器接受率,conf (B k)\operatorname{conf}(B_{k})是它的平均值报告的信心. 我们使用发布的执行p=2 p=2,β=40\β=40。 表9报告了接受和校准同一项活动的情况;校准目标是个人防伪接受,而不是联合企业的覆盖范围。

blocks.en: D.5 Prospective Formalization Resource
blocks.zh: D.5 前景正规化资源

blocks.en: The construction pipeline retains 221 compiler-valid Lean declarations from 398 natural-language challenges (55.5%) after the automated semantic checks in Section 3.3 . Table 1 gives the topic breakdown. The tested baseline agents produce zero accepted sorry-free Lean proofs on these candidates, which remain a prospective resource for formalization research.

blocks.en: Beyond the Library ( Moakhar et al., 2026 ) reports expert-validated statement-and-proof formalizations of seven selected papers, including five STOC papers, with public artifacts; two developments require no axioms beyond Lean’s kernel. These case studies demonstrate feasibility in selected settings and motivate expert audit of our candidates. Differences in task selection, context, libraries, axiom policies, and human validation make the results complementary rather than directly comparable.
blocks.zh: 在图书馆之外(Moakhar等人,2026年),有7篇选定的论文(包括5篇STOC论文)经过专家验证和校准,并附有公共文物;两项发展不需要超越Lean的内核。 这些案例研究表明,在选定的环境中是可行的,并激励专家对我们的候选人进行审计。 任务选择、背景、图书馆、轴心政策和人类验证等方面的差异使结果相辅相成而不是直接可比。

blocks.en: This appendix records representative construction and proof-agent prompts. Instruction wording is preserved, and the external verifier’s framing adjustment is noted in Appendix E.2.2 . blocks.en: E.1 Challenge Generation Pipeline

blocks.en: E.1.1 Challenge Selection and Assembly
blocks.zh: E.1.1 选择和集会的挑战

blocks.en: The selector receives the extracted statement catalogue and returns headline theorem IDs and the context IDs needed to understand them. Code assembles the corresponding source text after proof-graph extraction (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 选择者接收提取的语句目录,并返回标题定理ID和理解它们所需的上下文ID. 代码在校对图提取后组装相应的源文本(Appendix B ).

blocks.en: E.1.2 Challenge Refinement
blocks.zh: E.1.2 改进挑战

blocks.en: The templates below cover self-containment, glossary matching, and existence rewriting within the expert-designed sequence in Appendix B.3 . Other passes complete references, notation, information access and action order, and assumption names. Intermediate-result removal is deterministic and has no LLM prompt.
blocks.zh: 以下模板涵盖附录B.3中专家设计的序列内的自我约束、词汇匹配和存在重写。 其他文件通过完整的参考资料、注释、信息获取和行动命令以及假设名称。 中间结果清除具有决定性,没有及时的LLM。

blocks.en: The checker receives the target theorem, included definitions, and remaining statement catalogue. Its missing entries guide context additions; gaps without an available definition remain recorded for later repair.
blocks.zh: 检查者收到目标定理,包括定义,以及剩余的语句目录. 其缺少的条目指南上下文添加;没有可用定义的漏洞仍然被记录下来,以便日后修复.

blocks.en: Given unresolved terms and the source glossary, this pass returns matching glossary indices; code inserts the corresponding definition text.
blocks.zh: 鉴于尚未解决的术语和源词汇表,此通过返回匹配的词汇索引;代码插入相应的定义文本.

blocks.en: The final rewriting pass converts references to named paper algorithms into existence claims. Its expert-designed preservation and scoping rules constrain unintended uses of supplied black-box objects and define the permitted statement changes. Code separately removes the corresponding algorithm pseudocode blocks.
blocks.zh: 最终的重写通行证将命名的纸质算法的引用转换为存在索赔. 其专家设计的保存和范围界定规则限制对所供应的黑盒物体的意外使用,并界定允许的语句更改。 代码单独删除相应的算法伪代码块.

blocks.en: E.2 Proof Agent
blocks.zh: E.2 证明代理人

blocks.en: Proof-agent inputs consist of the challenge, its definitions and assumptions, and retrieved cited prior work. Source-paper lemmas and the target proof are withheld. Ancestor goals, sibling subgoals, and decomposition children are claims created during search; empty histories and optional context blocks are omitted at runtime. The external scoring verifier receives separate inputs, specified below.
blocks.zh: 证明人的投入包括挑战、其定义和假设,并检索了先前引用的工作。 源纸lemma 和目标证明被扣. 祖先目标,兄弟子目标和分解儿童是搜索过程中产生的主张;空历史和可选上下文块在运行时省略. 外部评分核查员收到单独的输入,具体如下.

blocks.en: E.2.1 Prover
blocks.zh: E.2.1 普罗维尔

blocks.en: The settings share prover and verifier role prompts but differ in how roles are invoked and what context is supplied (Appendix C ). Direct inference invokes the prover once; discussion adds verifier feedback and revision. Search-context fields are populated when applicable.
blocks.zh: 设置共享验证器和验证器角色提示,但在如何引用角色和提供何种上下文方面有所不同(附录C )。 直接推论一次引用证明人;讨论增加验证人的反馈和修订. 搜索文本字段在适用时均被覆盖。

blocks.en: The listing combines the base prover instructions with the composite-loop extension, followed by the user template for a direct-proof action. References to the decider, disproof, and decomposition describe composite-loop actions; direct inference performs only its single proof-generation call. The current goal’s discussion, ancestor goals, and prior strategy summaries are runtime context, subject to the workflow’s limits.
blocks.zh: 列表将基础验证指令与复合roop扩展合并,然后是用户模板,用于直接防守动作. 对决定者的引用,解脱和分解描述复合-loop动作;直接推论只进行其单一的证明生成调用. 目前的目标讨论、祖先目标和前期战略摘要是运行时间背景,但受工作流程的限制。

blocks.en: After a verifier objection, the dialogue helper supplies this repair message.
blocks.zh: 在验证员反对后,对话框助手会提供此修补消息.

blocks.en: E.2.2 Verifier
blocks.zh: E.2.2 核证

blocks.en: Our proof-agent and verification prompts adapt BrokenMath’s checks for false premises and unsupported proof attempts ( Petrov et al., 2025 ) and QED’s structural-then-detailed verification, including statement integrity, citation checking, and uncertain steps ( An et al., 2026 ) . We add TCS-specific checks for assumptions, information access and action order, and quantitative guarantees. The listings document these adaptations.
blocks.zh: 我们的验证代理和核查提示调整了BrokenMath对虚假房地和无根据举证尝试的检查(Petrov等人,2025年)和QED当时的结构详细核查,包括声明的完整性、引用核对和不确定步骤(An等人,2026年)。 我们增加了针对假设、信息获取和行动秩序以及数量保障的TCS具体检查。 列出这些修改的文件。

blocks.en: The internal verifier critiques proof or disproof attempts using the current argument, stored node attempts, and relevant subgoal statements and statuses. The listing includes the opening policy, final checklist, and user-template structure. Omitted system instructions check quantifiers, admissible constructions, bounds, circularity, specification gaps, vacuity, unstated hypotheses, and unsupported steps; omitted user blocks contain action-specific and subgoal-citation checks.
blocks.zh: 内部核查员利用当前的论点、存储节点的尝试以及相关次级目标声明和状态,对证明或解密尝试提出批评。 清单包括开放政策、最后清单和用户模板结构。 Omited系统指令检查限定符,可接受构造,界限,循环,规格缺口,挥发,未声明的假说,以及不支持的步骤;省略的用户块包含特定动作和次级目标引用的检查.

blocks.en: Before external scoring, a proof-organizing step checks whether statements cited from prior work match their original source statements. Three separately sampled GPT-5.5 high-effort voters then receive only the original problem and rewritten final proof; at least two PASS votes determine acceptance, independently of internal search verdicts (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 在外部评分之前,一个验证组织步骤检查前作中引用的语句是否与其原始源语句相符. 三个分别抽样的GPT-5.5高功率选民随后只收到原始问题并重写最终证明;至少有两个PASS的选票决定接受,独立于内部搜索判决(Appendix C.).

blocks.en: The listing gives one voter’s system and user templates, with no additional rules. The same scoring template applies across settings; its decomposition-specific framing is generalized here, with verification criteria unchanged. Implementation phase numbers are retained: structural phases 1, 2, 3, and 5 precede detailed phase 6. Phase 4 (decomposition-plan adherence) and the decomposition-state block are disabled.
blocks.zh: 名单给出了一个选民系统和用户模板,没有其他规则。 同一评分模板适用于不同的设置;其分解特定框架在此得到普遍采用,核查标准不变。 保留执行阶段编号:结构阶段1、2、3和5在详细阶段之前 6. 第四阶段(分解-计划坚持)和分解-状态区块被禁用.

blocks.en: E.2.3 Decomposer
blocks.zh: E.2.3 拆解器

blocks.en: The decomposer proposes alternative reductions, each requiring all child claims, and reuses the composite prover system prompt in Appendix E.2.1 . The user template below has empty optional hint and discussion blocks; failed reductions, strategy summaries, and rejection feedback are inserted when available. Candidate reductions are checked before their children are attached to the search graph.
blocks.zh: 分解器提出了替代减量,每个减量都要求所有的儿童索赔要求,并重新使用附录E.2.1中提示的综合验证系统。 下面的用户模板有空的可选提示和讨论块;失败的减少,策略摘要,以及拒绝反馈等在可用时被插入. 候选人的减少数在子女被附在查询图上之前进行核对。

blocks.en: The decomposition and planning templates request one to three candidates. Execution follows the workflow limits in Appendix C : root-only decomposition uses one depth-1 plan per attempt, MCTS can recursively expand subgoals, and agentic planning revises a lemma DAG.
blocks.zh: 分解和规划模板要求一至三名候选人. 执行遵循附录C中的工作流程限制 : root-least解析每次尝试使用一个深度-1计划,MCTS可以递归扩展子目标,代理规划修改一个lemma DAG.

blocks.en: If no candidate reduction is accepted, the next expansion receives this feedback block. Its placeholder contains rejected children, the previous recombination explanation, variable-scope, assumption, and triviality check outcomes, the verifier diagnosis, and conditional repair instructions.
blocks.zh: 如果不接受候选人的减少,下一次扩大将收到这一反馈。 其占位符中包含被拒绝的儿童、先前的重组解释、可变范围、假设和微小的检查结果、核实者诊断以及有条件的修复指示。

blocks.en: E.2.4 Planner and Plan Refinement

blocks.en: The planner proposes an ordered dependency graph of intermediate claims. For each step, code adds the conclusions of earlier steps listed in depends_on to its assumptions.
blocks.zh: 规划人员提出了中间索赔的有序依赖图。 对于每个步骤,代码会在其假设中添加dependy_on中列出的早期步骤的结论.

blocks.en: The failure-feedback placeholder contains the root outcome, estimated search value, number of composite attempts, each reduction’s open and dead subgoal counts, and truncated unclosed subgoal statements with their last objections. The revised plan seeds a fresh search root. Only the user request changes; the system prompt, output schema, and requirements are reused, with repeated material omitted below.
blocks.zh: 失败反馈占位符包含根本结果、估计搜索值、综合尝试次数、每项削减的开放式和已死次级目标计数,以及带有最后反对意见的未关闭次级目标声明。 修订后的计划植入了新的搜索根基。 只有用户请求更改;系统即时,输出计划,以及要求被重新使用,下面省略了重复的材料.
